authorJudgements.what: D-V2 by the rule, not by a filter
authorJudgements.chosen: the build’s highlight rule over the datasets with points for ≥ 90 %, then the cap of four (js/model.js#highlightsOf)
authorJudgements.why: the decision says “นับเฉพาะชุดที่มีพิกัดตั้งแต่ 90%”: a complete dataset the cap had cut comes back. The proposal’s figures filtered the file’s list after the cap: 459 highlights; by the rule 529 (599 in the file), and สยาม keeps four (สถานีราง comes back)

authorJudgements.what: a glyph of its own for industrial estates
authorJudgements.why: factory registrations already take factory; sixteen distinct glyphs keep the column key unambiguous
authorJudgements.rejected: factory for both, as «รอบศูนย์นี้» does

authorJudgements.chosen: a visible key of every dataset’s pictogram and name under the matrices of the overview and the comparison; none under the neighbourhood’s similar matrix, where the axes above name all 16 beside their pictograms
authorJudgements.why: LDS ICON-01: an icon never stands in for a category’s label; the proposal had the names only in titles and for screen readers
authorJudgements.rejected: names only in title and screen-reader text

authorJudgements.what: row height of the axes and the matrix
authorJudgements.chosen: 44 px rows (the dataset’s name sets the map’s lens; a neighbourhood’s name opens it)
authorJudgements.why: LDS CTRL-01: a direct control is at least 44 CSS px; the mockups’ rows were 30 px

authorJudgements.chosen: an outbound icon link (nav-7 open_in_new, 44 × 44) at the end of each row of the axes
authorJudgements.why: §4.2: the link moves from the highlight to the dataset’s row
authorJudgements.rejected: a text link under the name

authorJudgements.what: the neighbourhoods that stand out on several fronts
authorJudgements.chosen: the matrix (§4.5) with the datasets of the top tenth under each row
authorJudgements.why: §4.5 names it among the four places of the matrix, and the matrix is a real table for screen readers
authorJudgements.rejected: the list of f8 (a fingerprint per row inside a button)

authorJudgements.chosen: the matrix for the first 30 (most distinctive first), the rest as names in a closed part
authorJudgements.why: keeps a province’s page light (Bangkok has 88 neighbourhoods)
